verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ أَلِيفَازُ ٱلتَّيْمَانِيُّ وَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
verses.web: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּימָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

verses.ar: «أَلَعَلَّ ٱلْحَكِيمَ يُجِيبُ عَنْ مَعْرِفَةٍ بَاطِلَةٍ، وَيَمْلَأُ بَطْنَهُ مِنْ رِيحٍ شَرْقِيَّةٍ،
verses.kjv: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?
verses.web: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
verses.he: הֶֽחָכָ֗ם יַעֲנֶ֥ה דַֽעַת־ר֑וּחַ וִֽימַלֵּ֖א קָדִ֣ים בִּטְנֹֽו׃

verses.ar: فَيَحْتَجَّ بِكَلَامٍ لَا يُفِيدُ، وَبِأَحَادِيثَ لَا يَنْتَفِعُ بِهَا؟
verses.kjv: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
verses.web: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?
verses.he: הֹוכֵ֣חַ בְּ֭דָבָר לֹ֣א יִסְכֹּ֑ון וּ֝מִלִּ֗ים לֹא־יֹועִ֥יל בָּֽם׃

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنْتَ فَتُنَافِي ٱلْمَخَافَةَ، وَتُنَاقِضُ ٱلتَّقْوَى لَدَى ٱللهِ.
verses.kjv: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.
verses.web: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.
verses.he: אַף־אַ֭תָּה תָּפֵ֣ר יִרְאָ֑ה וְתִגְרַ֥ע שִׂ֝יחָ֗ה לִפְנֵי־אֵֽל׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ فَمَكَ يُذِيعُ إِثْمَكَ، وَتَخْتَارُ لِسَانَ ٱلْمُحْتَالِينَ.
verses.kjv: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
verses.web: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
verses.he: כִּ֤י יְאַלֵּ֣ף עֲוֹנְךָ֣ פִ֑יךָ וְ֝תִבְחַ֗ר לְשֹׁ֣ון עֲרוּמִֽים׃

verses.ar: إِنَّ فَمَكَ يَسْتَذْنِبُكَ، لَا أَنَا، وَشَفَتَاكَ تَشْهَدَانِ عَلَيْكَ.
verses.kjv: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
verses.web: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
verses.he: יַרְשִֽׁיעֲךָ֣ פִ֣יךָ וְלֹא־אָ֑נִי וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ יַעֲנוּ־בָֽךְ׃

verses.ar: «أَصُوِّرْتَ أَوَّلَ ٱلنَّاسِ أَمْ أُبْدِئْتَ قَبْلَ ٱلتِّلَالِ؟
verses.kjv: [Art] thou the first man [that] was born? or wast thou made before the hills?
verses.web: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?
verses.he: הֲרִאישֹׁ֣ון אָ֭דָם תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וְלִפְנֵ֖י גְבָעֹ֣ות חֹולָֽלְתָּ׃

verses.ar: هَلْ تَنَصَّتَّ فِي مَجْلِسِ ٱللهِ، أَوْ قَصَرْتَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ؟
verses.kjv: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?
verses.web: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
verses.he: הַבְסֹ֣וד אֱלֹ֣והַ תִּשְׁמָ֑ע וְתִגְרַ֖ע אֵלֶ֣יךָ חָכְמָֽה׃

verses.ar: مَاذَا تَعْرِفُهُ وَلَا نَعْرِفُهُ نَحْنُ؟ وَمَاذَا تَفْهَمُ وَلَيْسَ هُوَ عِنْدَنَا؟
verses.kjv: What knowest thou, that we know not? [what] understandest thou, which [is] not in us?
verses.web: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?
verses.he: מַה־יָּ֭דַעְתָּ וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע תָּ֝בִ֗ין וְֽלֹא־עִמָּ֥נוּ הֽוּא׃

verses.ar: عِنْدَنَا ٱلشَّيْخُ وَٱلْأَشْيَبُ، أَكْبَرُ أَيَّامًا مِنْ أَبِيكَ.
verses.kjv: With us [are] both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.
verses.web: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.
verses.he: גַּם־שָׂ֣ב גַּם־יָשִׁ֣ישׁ בָּ֑נוּ כַּבִּ֖יר מֵאָבִ֣יךָ יָמִֽים׃

verses.ar: أَقَلِيلَةٌ عِنْدَكَ تَعْزِيَاتُ ٱللهِ، وَٱلْكَلَامُ مَعَكَ بِٱلرِّفْقِ؟
verses.kjv: [Are] the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?
verses.web: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?
verses.he: הַמְעַ֣ט מִ֭מְּךָ תַּנְחֻמֹ֣ות אֵ֑ל וְ֝דָבָ֗ר לָאַ֥ט עִמָּֽךְ׃

verses.ar: «لِمَاذَا يَأْخُذُكَ قَلْبُكَ؟ وَلِمَاذَا تَخْتَلِجُ عَيْنَاكَ
verses.kjv: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,
verses.web: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,
verses.he: מַה־יִּקָּחֲךָ֥ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וּֽמַה־יִּרְזְמ֥וּן עֵינֶֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: حَتَّى تَرُدَّ عَلَى ٱللهِ وَتُخْرِجَ مِنْ فِيكَ أَقْوَالًا؟
verses.kjv: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest [such] words go out of thy mouth?
verses.web: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?
verses.he: כִּֽי־תָשִׁ֣יב אֶל־אֵ֣ל רוּחֶ֑ךָ וְהֹצֵ֖אתָ מִפִּ֣יךָ מִלִּֽין׃

verses.ar: مَنْ هُوَ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ حَتَّى يَزْكُوَ، أَوْ مَوْلُودُ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ حَتَّى يَتَبَرَّرَ؟
verses.kjv: What [is] man, that he should be clean? and [he which is] born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.web: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.he: מָֽה־אֱנֹ֥ושׁ כִּֽי־יִזְכֶּ֑ה וְכִֽי־יִ֝צְדַּ֗ק יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה׃

verses.ar: هُوَذَا قِدِّيسُوهُ لَا يَأْتَمِنُهُمْ، وَٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ غَيْرُ طَاهِرَةٍ بِعَيْنَيْهِ،
verses.kjv: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
verses.web: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;
verses.he: הֵ֣ן *בִּקְדֹשֹׁו (בִּ֭קְדֹשָׁיו) לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וְ֝שָׁמַ֗יִם לֹא־זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃

verses.ar: فَبِالْحَرِيِّ مَكْرُوهٌ وَفَاسِدٌ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ ٱلشَّارِبُ ٱلْإِثْمَ كَٱلْمَاءِ!
verses.kjv: How much more abominable and filthy [is] man, which drinketh iniquity like water?
verses.web: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!
verses.he: אַ֭ף כִּֽי־נִתְעָ֥ב וְֽנֶאֱלָ֑ח אִישׁ־שֹׁתֶ֖ה כַמַּ֣יִם עַוְלָֽה׃

verses.ar: «أُوحِي إِلَيْكَ، ٱسْمَعْ لِي فَأُحَدِّثَ بِمَا رَأَيْتُهُ،
verses.kjv: I will shew thee, hear me; and that [which] I have seen I will declare;
verses.web: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare
verses.he: אֲחַוְךָ֥ שְֽׁמַֽע־לִ֑י וְזֶֽה־חָ֝זִ֗יתִי וַאֲסַפֵּֽרָה׃

verses.ar: مَا أَخْبَرَ بِهِ حُكَمَاءُ عَنْ آبَائِهِمْ فَلَمْ يَكْتُمُوهُ.
verses.kjv: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid [it:]
verses.web: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;
verses.he: אֲשֶׁר־חֲכָמִ֥ים יַגִּ֑ידוּ וְלֹ֥א כִֽ֝חֲד֗וּ מֵאֲבֹותָֽם׃

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ وَحْدَهُمْ أُعْطِيَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ، وَلَمْ يَعْبُرْ بَيْنَهُمْ غَرِيبٌ.
verses.kjv: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.
verses.web: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):
verses.he: לָהֶ֣ם לְ֭בַדָּם נִתְּנָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְלֹא־עָ֖בַר זָ֣ר בְּתֹוכָֽם׃

verses.ar: ٱلشِّرِّيرُ هُوَ يَتَلَوَّى كُلَّ أَيَّامِهِ، وَكُلَّ عَدَدِ ٱلسِّنِينَ ٱلْمَعْدُودَةِ لِلْعَاتِي.
verses.kjv: The wicked man travaileth with pain all [his] days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
verses.web: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
verses.he: כָּל־יְמֵ֣י רָ֭שָׁע ה֣וּא מִתְחֹולֵ֑ל וּמִסְפַּ֥ר שָׁ֝נִ֗ים נִצְפְּנ֥וּ לֶעָרִֽיץ׃

verses.ar: صَوْتُ رُعُوبٍ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ. فِي سَاعَةِ سَلَامٍ يَأْتِيهِ ٱلْمُخَرِّبُ.
verses.kjv: A dreadful sound [is] in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
verses.web: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
verses.he: קֹול־פְּחָדִ֥ים בְּאָזְנָ֑יו בַּ֝שָּׁלֹ֗ום שֹׁודֵ֥ד יְבֹואֶֽנּוּ׃

verses.ar: لَا يَأْمُلُ ٱلرُّجُوعَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلْمَةِ، وَهُوَ مُرْتَقَبٌ لِلسَّيْفِ.
verses.kjv: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.
verses.web: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
verses.he: לֹא־יַאֲמִ֣ין שׁ֭וּב מִנִּי־חֹ֑שֶׁךְ *וְצָפוּ (וְצָפ֖וּי) ה֣וּא אֱלֵי־חָֽרֶב׃

verses.ar: تَائِهٌ هُوَ لِأَجْلِ ٱلْخُبْزِ حَيْثُمَا يَجِدْهُ، وَيَعْلَمُ أَنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلظُّلْمَةِ مُهَيَّأٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: He wandereth abroad for bread, [saying], Where [is it]? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
verses.web: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
verses.he: נֹ֘דֵ֤ד ה֣וּא לַלֶּ֣חֶם אַיֵּ֑ה יָדַ֓ע ׀ כִּֽי־נָכֹ֖ון בְּיָדֹ֣ו יֹֽום־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

verses.ar: يُرْهِبُهُ ٱلضُّرُّ وَٱلضَّيْقُ. يَتَجَبَّرَانِ عَلَيْهِ كَمَلِكٍ مُسْتَعِدٍّ لِلْوَغَى.
verses.kjv: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
verses.web: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
verses.he: יְֽ֭בַעֲתֻהוּ צַ֣ר וּמְצוּקָ֑ה תִּ֝תְקְפֵ֗הוּ כְּמֶ֤לֶךְ ׀ עָתִ֬יד לַכִּידֹֽור׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ مَدَّ عَلَى ٱللهِ يَدَهُ، وَعَلَى ٱلْقَدِيرِ تَجَبَّرَ
verses.kjv: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.
verses.web: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
verses.he: כִּֽי־נָטָ֣ה אֶל־אֵ֣ל יָדֹ֑ו וְאֶל־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְגַּבָּֽר׃

verses.ar: عَادِيًا عَلَيْهِ، مُتَصَلِّبُ ٱلْعُنُقِ بِأَوْقَافِ مَجَانِّهِ مُعَبَّأَةً.
verses.kjv: He runneth upon him, [even] on [his] neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:
verses.web: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,
verses.he: יָר֣וּץ אֵלָ֣יו בְּצַוָּ֑אר בַּ֝עֲבִ֗י גַּבֵּ֥י מָֽגִנָּֽיו׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ قَدْ كَسَا وَجْهَهُ سَمْنًا، وَرَبَّى شَحْمًا عَلَى كِلْيَتَيْهِ،
verses.kjv: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on [his] flanks.
verses.web: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.
verses.he: כִּֽי־כִסָּ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּחֶלְבֹּ֑ו וַיַּ֖עַשׂ פִּימָ֣ה עֲלֵי־כָֽסֶל׃

verses.ar: فَيَسْكُنُ مُدُنًا خَرِبَةً، بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةٍ عَتِيدَةً أَنْ تَصِيرَ رُجَمًا.
verses.kjv: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, [and] in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.
verses.web: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.
verses.he: וַיִּשְׁכֹּ֤ון ׀ עָ֘רִ֤ים נִכְחָדֹ֗ות בָּ֭תִּים לֹא־יֵ֣שְׁבוּ לָ֑מֹו אֲשֶׁ֖ר הִתְעַתְּד֣וּ לְגַלִּֽים׃

verses.ar: لَا يَسْتَغْنِي، وَلَا تَثْبُتُ ثَرْوَتُهُ، وَلَا يَمْتَدُّ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ مُقْتَنَاهُ.
verses.kjv: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.
verses.web: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.
verses.he: לֹֽא־יֶ֖עְשַׁר וְלֹא־יָק֣וּם חֵילֹ֑ו וְלֹֽא־יִטֶּ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ מִנְלָֽם׃

verses.ar: لَا تَزُولُ عَنْهُ ٱلظُّلْمَةُ. خَرَاعِيبُهُ تُيَبِّسُهَا ٱلسُّمُومُ، وَبِنَفْخَةِ فَمِهِ يَزُولُ.
verses.kjv: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.
verses.web: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.
verses.he: לֹֽא־יָס֨וּר ׀ מִנִּי־חֹ֗שֶׁךְ יֹֽ֭נַקְתֹּו תְּיַבֵּ֣שׁ שַׁלְהָ֑בֶת וְ֝יָס֗וּר בְּר֣וּחַ פִּֽיו׃

verses.ar: لَا يَتَّكِلْ عَلَى ٱلسُّوءِ. يَضِلُّ. لِأَنَّ ٱلسُّوءَ يَكُونُ أُجْرَتَهُ.
verses.kjv: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.
verses.web: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.
verses.he: אַל־יַאֲמֵ֣ן *בַּשֹּׁו (בַּשָּׁ֣יו) נִתְעָ֑ה כִּי־שָׁ֝֗וְא תִּהְיֶ֥ה תְמוּרָתֹֽו׃

verses.ar: قَبْلَ يَوْمِهِ يُتَوَفَّى، وَسَعَفُهُ لَا يَخْضَرُّ.
verses.kjv: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.
verses.web: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.
verses.he: בְּֽלֹא־יֹ֭ומֹו תִּמָּלֵ֑א וְ֝כִפָּתֹ֗ו לֹ֣א רַעֲנָֽנָה׃

verses.ar: يُسَاقِطُ كَٱلْجَفْنَةِ حِصْرِمَهُ، وَيَنْثُرُ كَٱلزَّيْتُونِ زَهْرُهُ.
verses.kjv: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.
verses.web: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.
verses.he: יַחְמֹ֣ס כַּגֶּ֣פֶן בִּסְרֹ֑ו וְיַשְׁלֵ֥ךְ כַּ֝זַּ֗יִת נִצָּתֹֽו׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ جَمَاعَةَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ عَاقِرٌ، وَٱلنَّارُ تَأْكُلُ خِيَامَ ٱلرَّشْوَةِ.
verses.kjv: For the congregation of hypocrites [shall be] desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.
verses.web: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
verses.he: כִּֽי־עֲדַ֣ת חָנֵ֣ף גַּלְמ֑וּד וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ אָכְלָ֥ה אָֽהֳלֵי־שֹֽׁחַד׃

verses.ar: حَبِلَ شَقَاوَةً وَوَلَدَ إِثْمًا، وَبَطْنُهُ أَنْشَأَ غِشًّا».
verses.kjv: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.
verses.web: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
verses.he: הָרֹ֣ה עָ֭מָל וְיָ֣לֹד אָ֑וֶן וּ֝בִטְנָ֗ם תָּכִ֥ין מִרְמָֽה׃ ס
